source_issue.title: user menu popup is not available on the site setup pages

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses a bug where the user menu icon is missing from the left sidebar on site setup pages in Volto. It has been noted that this icon is typically part of the "DefaultViewButtons."

## What needs to be done
To fix this issue, we should remove the condition that hides the user icon based on the "DefaultViewButtons." This change will ensure that the user icon is always visible in the toolbar, regardless of the webpage.

## Helpful background
Several discussions indicate that a previous pull request (PR #4565) attempted to resolve this but was not successful and was closed. 

Contributors have also pointed out the need to adhere to contributions guidelines, particularly for new contributors.

## Good first steps
1. Review the existing discussions and PRs related to this issue.
2. Create a new PR that implements the suggested changes.
3. Make sure to follow the [Plone contribution guidelines](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/index.html) to ensure your changes are aligned with project standards.

Feel free to ask questions if anything is unclear. Your contributions are valuable, and we appreciate your help!
